---
title: "CDS ERA5 Table Diagnostic"
output: html_document
---

```{r check}
library(sparklyr)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)

sc <- spark_connect(method = "databricks")

cds <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("cds_era5", "silver", "era5_daily"))

# Schema sample
s <- cds %>% head(3) %>% collect()

# Distinct years for Sri Lanka if country col exists
cols <- colnames(cds)

# Row count + year range for Sri Lanka
lk <- cds %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  mutate(yr = year(time)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_pixels = n_distinct(longitude, latitude),
            min_yr = min(yr), max_yr = max(yr)) %>%
  collect()

results <- list(schema = s, cols = cols, sri_lanka = lk)
saveRDS(results, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/diag_cds_era5.rds")

cat("Columns:\n"); print(cols)
cat("\nSchema:\n"); print(s)
cat("\nSri Lanka:\n"); print(lk)

spark_disconnect(sc)
```
